R0_AlcoholStatus.title: Alcohol use status at baseline
R0_AlcoholStatus.x-derivation: Using questionnaire variables if ever been a regular drinker, and if still drinking at least one glass per week. Derived from: R0_AlcoholRegularUse, R0_AlcoholCurrentUse, R0_AlcoholStartAge, R0_AlcoholStopAge, R0_AlcoholConsumption_Num, R0_AlcoholBeer, R0_AlcoholRedWine, R0_AlcoholWhiteWine, R0_AlcoholSherry, R0_AlcoholSpirits, R0_AlcoholOther, AgeEntry

R0_AgeStartedDrinking.title: Age started regularly drinking alcohol
R0_AgeStartedDrinking.x-derivation: Using questionnaire variable at what age did you start drinking. Derived from: R0_AlcoholStartAge
R0_AgeStartedDrinking.$comment: Legacy name: alcoholstartage. Upper bound is a plausibility bound the source does not state -- agent-decided.

R0_AgeStoppedDrinking.title: Age stopped regularly drinking alcohol
R0_AgeStoppedDrinking.x-derivation: Using questionnaire variable at what age did you stop drinking. Derived from: R0_AlcoholStopAge
R0_AgeStoppedDrinking.$comment: Legacy name: alcoholstopage. Upper bound is a plausibility bound the source does not state -- agent-decided.

R0_AlcoholUnitsPerWeek.title: Weekly alcohol units among current drinkers
R0_AlcoholUnitsPerWeek.x-derivation: Average of weekly units of all alcohols asked about in age range at baseline. Derived from: R0_AlcoholConsumption_Num, R0_AlcoholBeer, R0_AlcoholRedWine, R0_AlcoholWhiteWine, R0_AlcoholSherry, R0_AlcoholSpirits, R0_AlcoholOther, R0_AlcoholCurrentUse, AgeEntry
R0_AlcoholUnitsPerWeek.$comment: Legacy name: R1alcoholunits. Upper bound is a plausibility bound the source does not state -- agent-decided.
